meta.name: lsp
meta.description: Use when Codex needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks in the current workspace.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编辑器中获取代码诊断、定义跳转和引用查找
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码编辑器中快速定位定义、引用或检查重命名安全
copy.tagline_en: Get language diagnostics, definitions, references, and rename safety in your editor
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick access to definitions, references, and rename safety in your code editor

howto.what: 装上后,助手会调用语言服务器来完成代码检查:返回诊断信息、定位定义、查找引用、列出符号,并在重命名前先验证是否安全。
howto.when: 当你在当前工作区需要代码诊断、符号定义/引用或重命名安全检查时触发。

say.text: 看看 src/index.ts 有哪些报错
say.note: 返回该文件的诊断结果

say.text: 帮我找一下 openEditor 函数的定义位置
把 helper 改名为 format 前,先查一下是否安全

howto.what_en: After installation, the assistant can call language-server tools to retrieve code diagnostics, locate definitions/references, inspect symbols, and check rename safety, then report the results back.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask in the current workspace for code diagnostics, symbol definitions/references, or rename-safety checks.

say_en.text: Are there any errors in src/index.ts?
Where is the openEditor function defined?
